description: The line plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” illustrates the maximum activation values across model layers for four distinct components: `attn_output` (blue dashed line), `attn_residual` (green dash-dot line), `ffn_residual` (red solid line), and an unlabeled gray shaded region in the legend (which does not appear as a plotted line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 400 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 50. The red solid line (`ffn_residual`) begins near 0 at Layer 0, rises gradually to about 50 by Layer 15, then steeply increases to nearly 400 by Layer 23. The orange dotted line (`attn_residual`) follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly below the red line, reaching approximately 260 at Layer 23. The blue dashed line (`attn_output`) stays near 0 until Layer 15, then rises sharply to about 110 by Layer 23. The green dash-dot line (`attn_residual` — note: legend labels two components as “attn_residual”, likely a typo; this green line corresponds to the second “attn_residual” entry) remains near 0 until Layer 20, then climbs steeply to about 170 by Layer 23. The gray shaded region in the legend has no corresponding plotted data.
